<js>
source_url="https://novel-api.xiaoppkk.com/cdn/book/source/{{$.id}}.html";
result=java.ajax(source_url);
eval(String(source.bookSourceComment));
data=JSON.parse(result).result.list;

v=String(book.getVariable("custom"));
var v=v.match(/^\d+$/)?v:0;
v=parseInt(v)<data.length?v:0;

con="\n使用说明：(根据序号设置书籍变量来切换来源(默认0))\n❗当前来源：序号【"+v+"】："+data[v].name;

for(var i=0;i<data.length;i++){
   con+="\n❤序号【"+i+"】："+data[i].name;

   con+="\n源ID："+data[i].source_id;	
		con+="\n源选择率："+data[i].show_text;
		con+="\n源地址："+data[i].chapter_list_url;
		con+="\n更新："+data[i].new_title;
			
}


 try{ book_id=data[v].internal_book_id; }
 catch(e) { book_id = java.getString('$.id');}
 
 if(v==0&&book_id==0){ 
 	book_id = java.getString('$.id');
 	tocUrl="/cdn/book/chapterList/"+java.put('book_id',book_id)+".html";
 }
else if(v!=0&&book_id==0) {
	 tUrl=data[v].chapter_list_url;
	 tocUrl=tUrl+"," + JSON.stringify({"headers":{"Referer": tUrl}});
	}
else if(book_id!=0){ 
		tocUrl="/cdn/book/chapterList/"+java.put('book_id',book_id)+".html";
	}

java.put('tocUrl',tocUrl); 
intro = " "+java.getString('$.description')+con;
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
if(baseUrl.match(/cdn\/book\/chapterList/)){
eval(String(source.bookSourceComment));
data = JSON.parse(result).result.list;
length = data.length;
chapterList = [];
for(var i = 0; i < length; i ++){
	name = "🏮〖"+data[i].name+"〗🏮";
	chapterList.push({
			text: name,
			href: null,
			volume: true
	})	
	data[i].list.forEach(($) => {						
		text = $.name;
		id = $.id;
    href = "/cdn/book/content/{{java.get('book_id')}}/"+id+".html";   
    chapterList.push({
			text: text,
			href: href	
	})
	})	
	}
chapterList
}
else{
	chapterList = [];
	datas = java.getElement("dd@a").toArray();
	//java.log(JSON.stringify(chapterList));
	for (var i = 0; i < datas.length; i++) {
    text = datas[i].text();
			hre = baseUrl.split(',')[0]+datas[i].attr("href");
			d=String(hre).split('\/');
list=[];
d.forEach((s, index)=>{ 
	 if (list.indexOf(s) == -1) {
 	   list.push(s);      }
		
		});
		href = list.toString().replace(/,/g,"/");
						
     chapterList.push({
		 	 text: text,
		  	 href: href	
      	})            
   };
	chapterList
	}
</js>

function fixNum(n) {
  return String(n)
    .replace(/(\d+)(\d)\d{7}/g, '$1.$2亿')
    .replace(/(\d+)(\d)\d{3}/g, '$1.$2万')
    .replace(/\.0([万亿])/g, '$1');
}

JSON.parse(String(result)).ranklist.map(o => {
  var subCateName = o.subCateName ? ' · ' + o.subCateName : '';
  var tags = [
    o.categoryName + subCateName,
    o.serialStatus == 0 ? '连载' : '完结'
  ];
  if (o.totalClick) {
    tags.push(fixNum(o.totalClick) + '点击');
  }
  if (o.number) {
    tags.push(fixNum(o.number) + '月票');
  }

  return {
    id: o.bookId,
    name: o.bookName,
    author: o.authorName,
    intro: o.description,
    kind: tags.join(','),
    last: o.updteChapterName,
    cover: 'http://static.zongheng.com/upload' + o.coverUrl,
    url: 'http://book.zongheng.com/book/' + o.bookId + '.html'
  };
});
</js>

教程：
（1）首先你得有个root的手机（面具或者KernelSU），（没有root的话可以用虚拟机或者使用集成版，转到第四步）
（2）然后在面具/KernelSU管理器安装LSPosed框架模块
（3）安装 番茄Web APP模块和指定版本的番茄小说APP，并在LSPosed管理器中点击番茄Web激活模块勾选番茄小说
（4）划掉后台重新启动番茄小说，并在设置中开启Web服务
（5）在阅读中导入书源即可使用，使用期间需要番茄小说保持后台运行，当然你也可以把你先看的小说缓存下来

 *  源变量介绍: status 后的 flase 表示关闭卷名显示，把它改为 true 表示开启；mode 后的 1 表示以模式一显示卷名，可修改为 2，2 的意思是模式二，依次类推；spacer 后的 "" 内的内容表示在模式二中，用 "" 内的文字分割卷名和章节名。

  function getTitle(x, name){
    if (variable["volume"]["status"] == true && variable["volume"]["mode"] == 2){
      return x.volume_name + (variable["volume"]["spacer"] || " | ") + name;
    } else {
      return name;
    }
  }
  let variable = source.getVariable();
  if(variable != "" && variable != null){
    try{
      variable = JSON.parse(variable);
    } catch(err) {
      java.log(err);
      variable = {"volume":{"status":false,"mode":1,"spacer":" | "}};
    }
  } else {
    variable = {"volume":{"status":false,"mode":1,"spacer":" | "}};
  }
  
  let data = JSON.parse(result).data.data.item_data_list;
  let array = [];
  let volumes = [];
  data.forEach((x) => {
    if(variable["volume"]["status"] == true && variable["volume"]["mode"] == 1){
      if (JSON.stringify(volumes).indexOf(x.volume_name) == -1) {
        array.push({
          title: x.volume_name,
          isVolume: true
        });
        volumes.push(x.volume_name);
      }
    }
    array.push({
      title: getTitle(x, x.title),
      url: 'content?item_id=' + x.item_id,
      updateTime: java.timeFormat(x.first_pass_time * 1000),
      isVolume: false
    })
  });

！！！请务必先登录

！请注意：
未经许可，请勿在其他平台转载此书源

可能会获得许可的转载方式：整理至「轻小说专用」的书源合集中

不可能获得许可的转载方式：上传至源仓库或整理至「非轻小说专用」的书源合集中

「轻小说专用」的定义：
有且仅有想看轻小说的人可能会添加

不论何种方式都需先征求书源作者的许可！

2023.10.12
酷安 @吉王义昊
源仓库里那个规则已经旧到完全无法导入了（怕不是2.0的）
大概试了下，原来的那些规则倒是都还能用
不过还有点bug，而且很多信息不全
就稍微完善了一下
- 处理了搜索列表规则，现在不会和详情页混淆
- 处理了标签的展示形式
- 完善了详情页规则
- 目录获取并标识卷名
- 解决了旧规则的乱码问题
- 为已下架的书添加了「已下架」标签
- 完善了发现页
2023.10.13
酷安 @吉王义昊
- 解决了部分书籍无法正常加载的问题
- 现在已下架的书也可以正常阅读了
- 解决了已下架的书在发现页无法正常加载的问题
2023.10.14
酷安 @吉王义昊
- 解决了发现页中排行榜获取到的链接不对的问题
2023.10.22
酷安 @吉王义昊
- 现在可以同时搜索作者和书名（但每一页的加载时间都增加至少5秒）
2023.10.25
酷安 @吉王义昊
- 使用 cookie 中的时间计算延迟
- 现在连续搜索时会自动延迟
- 添加延迟时提示消息

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
  let defaultVariable = {
    "volume": {
      "status": false,
      "mode": 1,
      "spacer": " | ",
      "emptyVolumeName": {
        "action": false,
        "replace": "第一卷：默认"
      },
      "onlyOneShow": false
    }
  }
  let variable = (book.getVariable("custom") != "" && book.getVariable("custom") != null) ? book.getVariable("custom") : source.getVariable();
  if(variable != "" && variable != null){
    try{
      variable = JSON.parse(variable);
    } catch(err) {
      java.log(err);
      variable = defaultVariable;
    }
  } else {
    variable = defaultVariable;
  }
  let data = JSON.parse(result).data;
  let list = data.chapterListWithVolume;
  let volume = data.volumeNameList;
  let chapters = [];
  let volume_names = [];
  for(let i in list){
    for(let x in list[i]){
      let c = list[i][x];
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 1 && volume_names.indexOf(c.volume_name) == -1){
        volume_names.push(c.volume_name);
        if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          chapters.push({
            title: ((c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace) ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name),
            isVolume: true
          });
        }
      }
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 2){
        if(c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace){
          c.title = (c.volume_name == "" ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name) + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        } else if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          c.title = c.volume_name + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        }
      }
      c.url  = `http://list.api-fanqienovel.sunianyun.live/random#/content?item_id=${c.itemId}`;
      chapters.push(c);
    }
  }
  chapters
</js>

key=java.get('key');
page=java.get('page');

//创建两个空数组
json=[];json2=[];

//判定json里是否有items
if(JSON.parse(result).items){
json=JSON.parse(result).items;}

//加载作者搜索页面并转为json
json1=JSON.parse(java.ajax('http://android.jjwxc.net/androidapi/search?keyword='+key+'&type=2&page='+page+'&searchType=2&sortMode=DESC'));

//判定json里是否有items
if(json1.items){
json2=json1.items
}

//书名搜索列表与作者搜索列表拼接
list=json.concat(json2);
Json=[];

//判断搜索结果是否含关键词
for(i in list){
if((list[i].novelname.indexOf(key)>-1||list[i].authorname.indexOf(key)>-1) && list[i].novelClass.indexOf('未知-未知-未知-未知')==-1){
Json.push(list[i])
}
}
result=JSON.stringify(Json)
</js>

	url: og('novel:read_url'),
};

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
  let defaultVariable = {
    "volume": {
      "status": false,
      "mode": 1,
      "spacer": " | ",
      "emptyVolumeName": {
        "action": false,
        "replace": "第一卷：默认"
      },
      "onlyOneShow": false
    }
  }
  let variable = (book.getVariable("custom") != "" && book.getVariable("custom") != null) ? book.getVariable("custom") : source.getVariable();
  if(variable != "" && variable != null){
    try{
      variable = JSON.parse(variable);
    } catch(err) {
      java.log(err);
      variable = defaultVariable;
    }
  } else {
    variable = defaultVariable;
  }
  let data = JSON.parse(result).data;
  let list = data.chapterListWithVolume;
  let volume = data.volumeNameList;
  let chapters = [];
  let volume_names = [];
  for(let i in list){
    for(let x in list[i]){
      let c = list[i][x];
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 1 && volume_names.indexOf(c.volume_name) == -1){
        volume_names.push(c.volume_name);
        if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          chapters.push({
            title: ((c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace) ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name),
            isVolume: true
          });
        }
      }
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 2){
        if(c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace){
          c.title = (c.volume_name == "" ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name) + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        } else if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          c.title = c.volume_name + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        }
      }
      c.url  = source.bookSourceUrl +  `/content?item_id=${c.itemId}`;
      chapters.push(c);
    }
  }
  chapters
</js>

    }

      java.log(err);
      variable = defaultVariable;
    }
  } else {
    variable = defaultVariable;
  }
  let data = JSON.parse(result).data;
  let list = data.chapterListWithVolume;
  let volume = data.volumeNameList;
  let chapters = [];
  let volume_names = [];
  for(let i in list){
    for(let x in list[i]){
      let c = list[i][x];
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 1 && volume_names.indexOf(c.volume_name) == -1){
        volume_names.push(c.volume_name);
        if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          chapters.push({
            title: ((c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace) ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name),
            isVolume: true
          });
        }
      }
      if(variable.volume.status == true && variable.volume.mode == 2){
        if(c.volume_name == "" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.action == "replace" && variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace){
          c.title = (c.volume_name == "" ? variable.volume.emptyVolumeName.replace : c.volume_name) + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        } else if(volume.length != 1 || variable.volume.onlyOneShow){
          c.title = c.volume_name + (variable.volume.spacer || " | ") + c.title;
        }
      }
      c.url  = source.bookSourceUrl +  `/content?item_id=${c.itemId}`;
      chapters.push(c);
    }
  }
  chapters

	url=java.get("url");
	code=String(url).replace(/\/sscc.*/,'')+"/member/getcode.asp";
	yzco=source.getVariable();
	function getOption(str,co){
  	hed={"Referer":url,"Cookie":co}
  	return JSON.stringify({"method":"POST",
"charset":"gb2312","body":"actyzm="+actyzm+"&yzm="+str+"&button="+button,"headers":hed});
  }
  function succes(){
		yzm=java.getVerificationCode(code);
		url+=","+getOption(yzm,"");
		hm=java.ajax(url);
		co=java.getCookie(url,"g3jy9sqo0ws");
   source.setVariable(yzm+',g3jy9sqo0ws='+co)
   return hm;
  }
	if(yzco&&yzco!=''){
		v=String(yzco).split(',');
		u=url+","+getOption(v[0],v[1]);
		result=java.ajax(u);
		if(/请输入验证码/.test(result)){
			java.longToast("  ！验证码过期或有误，重新获取  ！")
			result=succes();
		}

result
}catch(err){java.log(err);result}

java.setContent(lis[2],'')
num2=Number(java.getElement('tag.a').attr('href').split('_')[1].replace('.html',''))
c=(num2-num1)/2
java.log(c)

for(i in lis){
	name=lis[i].text()
	if(/链接已隐藏/.test(lis[i])){
		ur=surl.split('_')
		base=ur[0]

			java.setContent(lis[i],'')
			surl=java.getElement('tag.a').attr('href')
			}
	temp={
		"name":name,
		"surl":surl
		}
		list.push(temp)
	}
	//java.log(JSON.stringify(list))
	list

with(Magua) {
  function strToMd5(str) {
    let md5 = MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5");
    let bytes = md5.digest(String(str).getBytes());
    let stringBuffer = new StringBuilder();
    let bt = null;
    bytes.forEach(a => {
      bt = a & 0xff;
      if (bt < 16) {
        stringBuffer.append("0");
      }
      stringBuffer.append(Integer.toHexString(bt));
    });
    return stringBuffer.toString();
  }
}
function getSig(timestamp, params) {
  return strToMd5("45667191c50941a1a777dfbd84345fe8" + timestamp + params);
}

loginUrl:
<js>
// 工具类
var key = java.base64DecodeToByteArray("lXsAUe1NZEw6tAxM9w1Tpq2tU4la2+PwM8evj2C+yB0=")
var iv = java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA==")
var aes = Packages.cn.hutool.crypto.symmetric.AES("CBC","PKCS5Padding", key, iv)
var RandomUtil = Packages.cn.hutool.core.util.RandomUtil
// 参数
let userInfo = source.getLoginInfoMap()
let username = userInfo['手机号码/邮箱'].trim()
let password = userInfo['密码'].trim()
let app_version = "2.9.290"
let device_token = `shuke_${RandomUtil.randomNumbers(15)}`
let login_token = RandomUtil.randomString(32)
let account = `%E4%B9%A6%E5%AE%A2${RandomUtil.randomNumbers(12)}`
let uuid = `android${java.randomUUID()}`
var params = `app_version=${app_version}&device_token=${device_token}&login_token=${login_token}&account=${account}`
// 账号登录
function login(username, password){
  var loginUrl = `https://sk.hbooker.com/signup/login?${params}&login_name=${username}&passwd=${password}`
  var autoRegUrl = `https://sk.hbooker.com/signup/auto_reg?oauth_union_id=&app_version=${app_version}&gender=1&oauth_open_id=&device_token=${device_token}&channel=TX&oauth_type=&uuid=${uuid}`
  // 是否游客
  let isLogin = !source.getLoginHeader()
  let isAuto = username == '' || password == ''
  if(isAuto && !isLogin){ 
     throw new Error("请勿重复登录,如若需要请清除登录头和Cookie")
  }
  var url = isAuto ? autoRegUrl : loginUrl
  // 获取登录信息
  let res = JSON.parse(aes.decryptStr(java.ajax(url)))
  if(res.tip) {
    throw new Error(isAuto ? '自动登陆失败,请输入账号或切换网络重新登陆' : '账号登陆失败,请尝试切换网络或者等待几小时后重新登陆')
  }
  let login_token = res.data.login_token
  let user_code = res.data.user_code
  let reader_name = res.data.reader_info.reader_name
  let account = res.data.reader_info.account
  let rest_hlb = res.data.prop_info.rest_hlb
  java.toast(isAuto ? '自动登陆成功,若有账号请输入账号进行登陆' : `${reader_name}【剩余欢乐币:${rest_hlb}】,登录成功!`)
  // 获取书架
  let bookList = java.ajax(`https://sk.hbooker.com/bookshelf/get_shelf_list?app_version=${app_version}&device_token=${device_token}&login_token=${login_token}&account=${account}`)
  let shelf_list = JSON.parse(aes.decryptStr(bookList)).data.shelf_list[0]
  let shelf_id = shelf_list.shelf_id
  let reader_id = shelf_list.reader_id
  // 登录完成
  let header = {
    "app_version": String(app_version),
    "device_token": String(device_token),
    "login_token": String(login_token),
    "account": encodeURIComponent(account),
    "user_code": String(user_code),
    "shelf_id": String(shelf_id),
    "reader_name": encodeURIComponent(reader_name),
    "reader_id": String(reader_id),
    "rest_hlb": String(rest_hlb)
  }
  return JSON.stringify(header)
}
// 写入登录头
header = login(username,password)
source.putLoginHeader(header)
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
// 解密
function decrypt(str1, str2){
  let key = java.base64DecodeToByteArray(java.digestBase64Str(str2,"sha256"))
  let iv = java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA==")
  let aes = Packages.cn.hutool.crypto.symmetric.AES("CBC","PKCS5Padding", key, iv)
  return aes.decryptStr(str1)
}
let headerMap = source.getLoginHeaderMap()
// 获取密钥
let app_version = headerMap['app_version']
let device_token = headerMap['device_token']
let account = headerMap['account']
let login_token = headerMap['login_token']
let rest_hlb = headerMap['rest_hlb']
let key = "zG2nSeEfSHfvTCHy5LCcqtBbQehKNLXn"
let cid = baseUrl.match(/chapter_id=(\d+)/)[1]
let result = JSON.parse(decrypt(result,key))
let tip = result.tip
if(tip){
 java.toast(tip)
 throw new Error(tip)	
}
let cmd = result.data.command
// 正文内容
let body = java.ajax(`https://sk.hbooker.com/chapter/get_cpt_ifm?chapter_command=${cmd}&app_version=${app_version}&chapter_id=${cid}&login_token=${login_token}&account=${account}&device_token=${device_token}`)
let chInfo = JSON.parse(decrypt(body,key)).data.chapter_info
let unit_hlb = java.put('unit_hlb', chInfo.unit_hlb)
let content = decrypt(chInfo.txt_content,cmd)
let isPay = chInfo.is_paid && chInfo.auth_access == 0
let payText = `\n本章是VIP章节，购买后才能阅读\n本章需要${unit_hlb}币, 您有${rest_hlb}币,请点击右上角的购买按钮购买本章(请勿乱点)，购买后自动加入到个人书架！`
isPay ? content + payText : content 
</js>
